meta.name: test-strategy-generator
meta.description: Generate layered test strategy (unit/integration/e2e), golden tests for generators/parsers, and clear mocking boundaries. Use before major implementation or refactor.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前生成分层测试策略，明确模拟边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在实现或重构前设计全面的测试方案
copy.tagline_en: Generate layered test strategies with clear mocking boundaries before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design comprehensive test plans before implementation or refactoring

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成分层测试策略（单元/集成/端到端），包括生成器/解析器的黄金测试和明确的模拟边界。
howto.when: 在重大实现或重构之前，当你要求制定测试策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能生成测试策略。
say.note: Claude 会输出分层测试矩阵。

say.text: 为我的解析器写一个黄金测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试用例和预期输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a layered test strategy (unit/integration/e2e), including golden tests for generators/parsers and clear mocking boundaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered before major implementation or refactor when you ask for a test strategy.

say_en.text: Generate a test strategy for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a layered test matrix.

say_en.text: Write a golden test for my parser.
say_en.note: Claude generates test cases and expected output.
